summary:
Iteration 41 — Verified new tabbed layouts on /copilot (2 tabs) and /advisor (4 tabs), the /copilot?tab=tax deep-link, and the completion-notification side-effect. ALL PASS.

[COPILOT TABS] /copilot loads with data-testid=copilot-tabs. copilot-tab-cash 'Ρευστότητα & Εισπράξεις' is data-state=active by default; copilot-tab-tax is inactive. Cash tab renders CopilotChat + CollectionsAgent (Greek greeting 'Γεια σου! Είμαι το Copilot Λογιστηρίου' visible). After clicking copilot-tab-tax, data-state flips to active and [data-testid=tax-copilot-chat] becomes visible. No horizontal overflow on desktop 1920x800 or mobile 390x844 (0 offenders both tabs).

[DEEP-LINK] Direct navigation to /copilot?tab=tax loads with copilot-tab-tax data-state=active and tax-copilot-chat visible WITHOUT any click (server reads searchParams.tab). On /advisor overview, clicking [data-testid=advisor-ask-copilot] navigates to /copilot?tab=tax and the tax tab is immediately active — deep-link works end-to-end.

[ADVISOR TABS] /advisor renders data-testid=advisor-disclaimer alert above data-testid=advisor-tabs with all 4 triggers: advisor-tab-overview (default active), -opportunities, -profile, -kb. Overview shows 4 KPI cards (advisor-total-benefit ~2.636,28 €), the three quick-action buttons (year-end-link, forecast-link, advisor-ask-copilot) and 'Κορυφαίες ευκαιρίες' list. Opportunities tab shows advisor-opportunities with 7 advisor-opp-* items and apply/dismiss buttons (writable). Profile tab shows tax-profile-form + what-if-card + SalaryDividendSimulator. KB tab shows 23 advisor-rule-* entries grouped by category. Old inline chat card is CONFIRMED REMOVED from /advisor (no tax-copilot-chat testid on that page). No overflow on desktop 1920x800 or mobile 390x844 across all 4 tabs (0 offenders — TabsList uses flex-wrap correctly).

[COMPLETION NOTIFICATION] Logged in as office@koletsas.gr (firm owner). Existing advisor task 7246fa68-…-4ed52d53213b (code=advisor:rnd_super_deduction, status=open) on org fa82eab8-…-05a0f63f1002. Clicked [data-testid=task-done-7246fa68…] on /office/tasks. Result: sonner toast 'Η εκκρεμότητα ολοκληρώθηκε.' shown; page refreshed and the task was gone from 'Ανοιχτές' filter and present under 'Ολοκληρωμένες'. DB confirms: office_tasks.status='done', updated_at=2026-09-14T21:52:16Z. No exception thrown. Owner-guard verified: email_outbox row count remained 2 (unchanged, latest email is 21:22 from earlier assignment) — since firm.firmUserId === current user.id, sendMail is intentionally skipped. Reverted task to 'open' for cleanliness.

[REGRESSION] /office/advisor still renders the multi-client scan with the 'Παραγωγικότητα Συμβούλου' card (advisor-prod-assigned present, header text present). /office/kb-review still shows [data-testid=kb-refresh-button] ('Ανανέωση βάσης γνώσης').

[NOTES] Login submit button correctly shows 'Προετοιμασία φόρμας...' during hydration; the test waits until aria-busy!=true before clicking. First-attempt clicks on Radix TabsTrigger with force=True occasionally missed the state flip (transient) — retrying with locator.click() (no force) after wait_for_selector worked reliably. Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: src/app/actions/office.ts:154-178 — completion email is wrapped in try/catch and correctly guarded by firm.firmUserId !== user.id; good. Consider surfacing a warning row in email_outbox when the guard is skipped (e.g., audit log entry) so accountants can see 'no notification (self-completion)' — currently there is no observable trace.

src/app/actions/office.ts:142-150 — updateOfficeTaskAction has NO authorization check: any authenticated user could call it with an arbitrary task id and mutate status/dueDate/assignee for a task belonging to another org. resolveFirm() is only used for the email branch. Should verify the task belongs to an org the user has membership on (or same firm-linked org). HIGH priority security concern.
src/app/(app)/copilot/page.tsx:26 — activeTab parsing supports only 'tax' or 'cash' fallback (good). No test for arbitrary values that could break Radix; already guarded.
src/app/(app)/advisor/page.tsx uses `getCurrentUser` transitively via requireContext — non-null returns are fine here since requireContext throws/redirects. No changes needed.
seed_data_creation: Toggled office_task 7246fa68-…-4ed52d53213b from open→done then reverted to open. No new email_outbox rows (owner-guard correctly prevented sending).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Copilot has 2 tabs (cash/tax) driven by ?tab= searchParam. Advisor has 4 tabs (overview/opportunities/profile/kb). advisor-ask-copilot links to /copilot?tab=tax. Task completion email guarded by firm ownership: only fires when completer !== firm owner. Currently only owner exists on the demo firm, so end-to-end email-fire couldn't be observed live, but guard-path (no email, no exception, status persisted) is verified. To E2E the email branch a non-owner firm_members row must be added and its user must complete a task. Radix TabsTrigger clicks are reliable with locator.click() (avoid force=True which occasionally races before hydration).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only observation: updateOfficeTaskAction lacks org/firm membership authorization; reported as a HIGH-priority code-review comment for the main agent to address.
